propositions: Eleven rebar/host CloudWatch alarms use treat_missing_data=notBreaching despite watching offset-delta host metrics published unconditionally on every period, causing missing data (dead publisher) to be misread as health
When a host-observability probe dies or the host becomes unreachable, these alarms silently clear to OK instead of alarming because their metric publisher ceases emission
mirror_out_of_sync is genuinely silent on Gerrit REST/git ls-remote failures due to an else-branch that publishes nothing, making the alarm fail-open on live hosts with broken queries

Alarms with evaluation_periods=1 and datapoints_to_alarm=1 will flap on ordinary timer jitter (~22 of 24 periods present historically) once treat_missing_data is flipped to breaching without widening the evaluation window

The dead-man inversion was partially fixed for disk alarms (root_disk_pressure, gerrit_data_disk_high) but left unfixed in 10+ other host-published alarms across monitoring_ws7.tf, monitoring_s5.tf, monitoring_autodeploy.tf, and other files
